The '''2025 China Open''' (officially known as the '''Victor China Open 2025''' for sponsorship reasons) was a badminton tournament that took place at [[Changzhou Olympic Sports Centre|Olympic Sports Centre Gymnasium]] in [[Changzhou]], [[Jiangsu]], China from 22 to 27 July 2025 and had a total prize of $2,000,000.<ref name="pros"/><ref>{{cite web|title=Badminton schedule 2025: BWF World Tour Final and World Championships among big-ticket events for shuttlers |url=https://www.olympics.com/en/news/badminton-schedule-2025-tournament-calendar |publisher=Olympics.com|access-date=6 July 2025}}</ref>
{{TOC right}}

==Tournament==
The 2025 China Open was the eighteenth tournament of the [[2025 BWF World Tour]] and also part of the [[China Open (badminton)|China Open]] championships, which had been held since [[China Open (badminton)|1986]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=BadmintonRanks - Professional Badminton Data Statistics |url=https://badmintonranks.com/tournament?id=11469 |access-date=2025-07-25 |website=badmintonranks.com}}</ref> This tournament was organized by [[Chinese Badminton Association]], and sanctioned by the [[Badminton World Federation|BWF]].<ref name="pros">{{cite web|title=Victor China Open 2025|url=https://extranet.bwf.sport/docs/events/5259/docs/VICTOR%20China%20Open%202025%20Prospectus_Final.pdf |publisher=[[Badminton World Federation]] |access-date=6 July 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=2025 China Open |url=https://badmintonworldtour.com/event/2025-china-open/ |publisher=badmintonworldtour.com|access-date=6 July 2025}}</ref>

===Venue===
The tournament was held at [[Changzhou Olympic Sports Centre|Olympic Sports Centre Gymnasium]] in [[Changzhou]], [[Jiangsu]], China.<ref name="pros"/>

===Point distribution===
Below is the tables with the point distribution for each phase of the tournament based on the new [[BWF World Ranking#After 23 April 2024|BWF points system]] for the [[BWF World Tour Super 1000]] event starting in Week 29 2025.<ref>{{cite web |title=World Ranking System |url=https://extranet.bwf.sport/docs/document-system/81/1466/1471/Section%205.3.3.1%20-%20World%20Ranking%20System%20-%2011%20November%202023%20V3.1.pdf|publisher=[[Badminton World Federation]] |access-date=6 July 2025}}</ref>

===Prize money===
The total prize money for this year tournament was US$2,000,000. Distribution of prize money was in accordance with BWF regulations.<ref name="pros"/>
